jobs.description:
At West Northamptonshire Council, we’re looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Highways Development Management Engineer to join our Highways and Transport Service. You’ll be at the heart of shaping how new developments across the area impact our transport network, ensuring they deliver safe, high-quality and sustainable solutions.

In this role, you will assess the transport and highways impacts of planning applications, provide clear and practical technical advice, and negotiate with developers to secure the right improvements. You’ll play a key part in managing and coordinating developer contributions, including Section 106 and Section 278 agreements, and oversee the design and delivery of highways works funded by developers to ensure they meet the highest standards.

You’ll also work closely with colleagues, elected members, stakeholders and local communities to help create accessible, efficient and sustainable transport networks that support growth and improve quality of life across West Northamptonshire.

Our Benefits

You can also see our full list of employee benefits on our careers site here: Why you should work for us | West Northamptonshire Council.

What will you be doing?

You will be based in the Highways Development Team and work closely with colleagues across the wider transport service. Your role will focus on assessing the transport and highways impacts of new developments and ensuring that appropriate and sustainable infrastructure is delivered as part of the planning process.

Day to day, you will provide technical highways and transport advice on planning applications, negotiate with developers to secure necessary improvements, and oversee the design and delivery of works funded through Section 106 and Section 278 agreements. You will be responsible for coordinating developer contributions, ensuring they are effectively managed and aligned with local transport priorities.

Collaboration will be at the heart of your work, as you will engage regularly with planning, regeneration, and transport colleagues, as well as developers, contractors, and local stakeholders. You will also take ownership of budget management, risk monitoring, and progress reporting to ensure that all highways and transport improvements are delivered to a high standard.

An important part of your role will be helping to embed improved processes for managing developer funding, working with planning colleagues to make sure contributions are secured, allocated, and delivered efficiently.

About You

You should have a solid understanding of highways engineering principles and the development management process, together with knowledge of planning legislation, transport policy, and sustainability issues relevant to local government. Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential, as you will be working closely with colleagues, developers, planners, and other stakeholders to secure and deliver high-quality transport solutions.

You will be confident in reviewing technical drawings and transport assessments, able to provide clear advice and recommendations, and skilled at negotiating outcomes that balance growth with sustainable transport objectives. The ability to work independently, use your initiative, and manage competing priorities under pressure is vital.

Ideally, you will hold a degree in a relevant discipline such as civil engineering, highways, or transport planning, and have experience of preparing and presenting technical reports. Project management training and experience in handling Section 106 and Section 278 agreements would be an advantage, alongside a motivation to further develop your expertise in highways development management.

About Us

At West Northants Council, it’s about our people. People who thrive with ambition, bubble with new ideas, demand better ways of working, caring about every detail, and who never shy away from a challenge. Our culture is a gateway for new experiences. A place to forge new opportunities. To empower you in your career and unite you with like-minded people.

Our corporate values, THRIVE, stand for: Trust, High Performance, Respect, Innovate and Empower, they underpin everything we do and how we deliver services.

Glassbox's mission is to empower enterprises to shape trusted, frictionless digital experiences.

Glassbox is a leading force in shaping digital experiences. It helps organizations uncover digital issues, boost conversion rates, enhance accessibility, prevent fraud, and more. Leveraging AI-driven customer intelligence, Glassbox enables enterprises to deliver secure, proactive, and preventative digital experiences. Its solutions are trusted by highly regulated organizations, including SoFi, Cal, and many others. We are growing and have been recognized by G2 as one of 2024's Top 50 Software Companies in the world.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organized and customer-centric Onboarding and Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our team in a dynamic, hybrid role. This position serves as the critical bridge between the sales cycle and long-term customer value. Your primary focus will be owning the initial onboarding phase-acting as a project manager to ensure new customers are successfully implemented, trained, and realizing time-to-value as quickly as possible.

Because our account distribution is highly adaptable, the post-onboarding lifecycle will vary. Depending on the customer segment, product tier, and team capacity, you will either formally transition the customer to a dedicated ongoing CSM upon successful deployment, or you will retain the account and manage their long-term success and growth. You must be equally adept at rigorous project management and long-term relationship building.

What You Will Do?

Implementation & Onboarding (All Accounts)

Project Management: Lead post-sale kickoff meetings, align on customer goals, and develop tailored, time-bound onboarding project plans.
Platform Implementation: Pair with technical counterparts to guide customers through technical setup, integration configurations, and best practices to ensure a flawless deployment.
Training & Education: Conduct and schedule comprehensive product training sessions tailored to various user personas (e.g., admins, end-users, executive sponsors) to drive immediate platform adoption.
Time-to-Value Delivery: Monitor early adoption metrics and proactively address bottlenecks to ensure customers achieve their first defining moment of value within the targeted onboarding window.

Account Transition & Handoffs

Milestone Evaluation: Define and evaluate clear "graduation" criteria to determine when an account has successfully completed onboarding.
Internal Alignment: Collaborate with Sales, Support, CX, and the broader CS team to determine post-onboarding account ownership.
Seamless Handoffs: For accounts moving to a different CSM, prepare comprehensive handover documentation detailing the customer's goals, current health, potential risks, and technical setup, facilitating a warm introduction and smooth transition.

Ongoing Customer Success (For Retained Accounts)

Relationship Management: Serve as the trusted advisor and primary point of contact for a designated portfolio of post-onboarding customers.
Strategic Reviews: Conduct Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) / Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to demonstrate ROI, align on upcoming business objectives, and introduce relevant new features.
Retention & Growth: Identify expansion opportunities (upsells/cross-sells) and partner with Sales to execute them.
Health Monitoring: Continuously monitor customer health scores, proactively identifying churn risks and building robust mitigation strategies.
Customer Advocacy: Identify successful customers to participate in case studies, webinars, and referral programs.

What You Will Need?

Onboarding Experience: 3+ years of experience in onboarding project management.
Customer Success Experience: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation, or B2B SaaS Account Management.
Hybrid Skillset: Demonstrated ability to act as both a structured project manager (driving timelines and deliverables) and an empathetic relationship manager (driving long-term strategy).
Technical Aptitude: Strong ability to understand complex software, articulate basic setup issues to the appropriate parties in a timely manner, and clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; highly comfortable leading video presentations and executive-level meetings.
Tools: Proficiency with CRM and CS platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight, ChurnZero, Zendesk) and project management software (e.g., Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet).
Adaptability: Comfort operating in a flexible environment where account ownership and daily priorities can shift based on business needs.
BSFI: Experience in the BFSI field is a plus.

Our Commitment

At Glassbox, we value curiosity, ownership, and a constant drive to learn and improve, no matter the gender, age, nationality, religion, or background. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and that potential matters just as much as experience, and encourage people of all shapes and sizes to apply.

If this role excites you and you're motivated to make an impact - we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't meet every listed qualification.

Description:

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Trade Compliance Analyst to support our Global Trade Compliance program. This role is responsible for conducting, reviewing, tracking and documenting critical day-to-day compliance activities, including restricted party screening, sanctions and due diligence research, transaction analysis, compliance documentation management, and program recordkeeping.
The successful candidate will serve as a key operational partner within the compliance function, helping ensure that transactions, business relationships, and third-party engagements comply with applicable export control, sanctions, and trade regulations. This position is ideal for an individual who thrives in a data-intensive environment, enjoys deep research and upholding precise protocols, and demonstrates exceptional accuracy and attention to detail.
Candidates must possess strong investigative and analytical skills combined with disciplined documentation practices and the ability to identify potential compliance risks through data analysis and research.

Restricted Party Screening & Due Diligence

Conduct research on companies, individuals, ownership structures, corporate affiliations, and business relationships to support screening determinations.
Perform enhanced due diligence reviews on suppliers, customers, distributors, freight forwarders, research institutions, and other third parties.
Prepare clear, concise, and well-supported written analyses documenting screening outcomes and recommendations.

Data Analysis & Compliance Monitoring

Analyze large data sets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential trade compliance risks.
Support periodic compliance reviews of transactions, customer populations, third-party relationships, and business activities.
Validate and reconcile compliance-related data across multiple systems and databases.
Develop reports and metrics that support monitoring of compliance program effectiveness.

Summarize findings and provide risk-based recommendations for business stakeholders and compliance leadership.

Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready compliance records in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
Organize and manage screening documentation, due diligence files, approvals, classifications, and supporting evidence.
Support internal audits, external audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory inquiries.
Ensure compliance records are properly indexed, retained, and readily retrievable.
Contribute to continuous improvement of documentation processes and recordkeeping standards.

Program Support & Process Improvement

Collaborate with Legal, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, and other business functions to support compliance objectives.

Experience in investigative research, skip tracing, or similar entity research.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
